title: Reconnect fix: the game screen sometimes doesn't return after rejoining an online room
problem: In 2 of 5 CI runs the game screen didn't appear after rejoining a room (after quick match in 15 s; after a page reload mid-match in 20 s), with no game-code change between runs. Players could hit this after a reload or a dropped connection. The tests keep no evidence when it happens.
scope: Step 1, evidence: on failure the online and quick-match tests save both players' screens, page text, browser console and received room messages; the local server log is kept as a CI artifact

Step 2, reproduce: a reconnect stress test (npm run test:reconnect) that repeats reload, connection drop and quick-match cycles, with and without a 4x CPU slowdown, and records time-to-game for each cycle; runnable locally and through a manual CI workflow
Step 3, isolate: compare failing and passing cycles to confirm or reject each hypothesis in REP-005
Step 4, fix the root cause with the smallest change, plus a regression test that fails before the fix
Step 5, prove it: repeated stress runs and consecutive green CI runs
exclusions: Game rules, balance, RULES_VERSION and saves
Message format changes old clients can't handle (would need a replan)
Publishing the fix to players (needs PREPARE RELEASE and your Deploy)
Longer timeouts or retries in tests as the 'fix'

acceptance.text: npm run test:reconnect runs N cycles and prints per-cycle time-to-game, failures and the 95th percentile
Root cause named with evidence (log or message excerpt from a failing cycle), or NOT REPRODUCED after at least 300 cycles with the conditions tried listed
If reproduced: failure rate before the fix recorded; after the fix at least 100 slowed-down cycles with 0 failures
A forced failure in the online test produces the diagnostics files and the server log artifact
A regression test (unit or browser) that fails on the old code and passes on the fixed code
verify:full green on 3 consecutive CI runs; leak check stays 0; 63+ unit tests green; no rules or save changes
